t: A tiny eight-core Linux computer with a 3 TOPS AI helper.
steps: Buy the Cubie A7S from Arace or ameriDroid.
Get a 5 V 3 A USB-C power supply and a microSD card.
Get a USB-C to HDMI or DisplayPort adapter for a screen.
Download a Radxa OS image from the Radxa docs site.
Write the image to the microSD card with a free image writing app.
Boot the board and follow the Radxa quick start guide.
Open a terminal and run a short Python script.
Ask questions on the Radxa forum.
meta: Open Board. From $71.95. A few stores.
